tasks.title: Stop hung status line and hook processes, and refresh README captures from sample data
steps: Stop the 27 orphaned claude statusline processes.
Bound status line and hook input reads with a deadline; coalesce overlapping hook refreshes.
Make --test-use-sample apply before the first dashboard pass and keep sample callbacks on the UI thread.
Capture the tray view and report from sample and synthetic data; replace the old report PNGs.

Remove the dead Report charts appearance option and the chart styles only it could select; reinstall as 0.0.1.33; replace the stale catalog stat on the site.
decisions: Ghostex runs the status line through gxserver; when a slow call is abandoned, tokenusage was orphaned with the pipe still open and read until an end of stream that never came.
Blocked console and pipe reads ignore cancellation, so the 2-second deadline is raced and the abandoned read ends with the process.
Hook refreshes share a named semaphore per data directory plus a pending event, so at most one refresh runs and one more pass follows.
README captures use a synthetic data folder written through the real repository and history APIs; the folder was checked unchanged after capture.

The provider trend is the only chart left, so it keeps the smooth line and a single bar for a one-day window; stacked areas, steps, straight lines, multi-day bars, and two-hour slots were removed with the option.
